claims.claim: diff N previews a rewind; rewind N --only PATH takes back just that file. The diff command is verbatim from the README; the --only chip now names app/config.py (not the README's src/db.py) and shows the line it prints
claims.source: README.md:54 "rewindagents diff 12 # what taking it back to step 12 would change"; :55 "rewindagents rewind 12 --only src/db.py # take back just that file"; :245 "rewind N --only PATH puts back only those files"; screen line "+++ b/tests/test_config.py" is printed by `rewindagents diff 12` on the demo session (brand/demo/scenario.py; tests/test_vsl.py test_every_diff_line_on_screen_is_one_diff_12_prints_on_the_demo_session); tests/test_vsl.py test_every_command_on_screen_is_a_readme_or_demo_command replays the demo session and runs it
claims.note: NOT YET JUDGED (round 4, 2026-11-12, by the maker, not the claim-verifier). Was CLEAR for the chip 'rewindagents rewind 12 --only src/db.py' verbatim from README.md:55. On the demo session that command exits 1: 'rewindagents: no step after step 12 changed src/db.py; nothing to put back'. So the chip is now 'rewindagents rewind 12 --only app/config.py', which on the demo session exits 0 and prints 'session demo: rewind to step 12 of 14 (did change 1 files)' / '  restore  app/config.py' / '  this rewind is step 15; undo it with: ...'; the second line is shown under the chip. Checked by execution in tests/test_vsl.py test_every_command_on_screen_is_a_readme_or_demo_command. Needs the claim-verifier.
